correctness.rationale: Exact Bessel product identity follows from independent-prime Parseval, not a numerical inference. Laplace asymptotics give \(v(n)=K/[n(\log n)^{d/2}](1+O(1/\log n))\); bounded sum--integral corrections and their \(O(\delta)\) differences transfer elementary Gamma/Laplace constants to the sums. Dominated convergence gives J_d iff \(d\ge5\). The proof explicitly establishes all domains and d boundaries; checker passes 125 finite corroborations. Source: self-contained RESULT.md, checker.py.
